name: Ammit
author: James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope
pageNumbering: page index, counting the cover as page 1. The folios have no visible printed page numbers.
reskinEvidence: Checked the rendered Monster Manual folio and the official 2014 Basic Rules on D&D Beyond. The mobile viewer counts its cover as page 1.
printedChanges: Use the Giant Crocodile as recommended on page 30. The paragraph gives no mechanical changes.
appearanceEvidence: page 30 calls it crocodilian. James Wyatt’s Wizards-published story Brazen describes the leonine body, alligator muzzle, red eyes, and thick hide. The long crocodilian tail and surface textures are art interpretation.
habitatEvidence: The trials are explicit on page 30. Amonkhet desert is inferred from the Demons section’s placement of its demonic fauna in the desert around Ifnir. Swamp is inherited index metadata from Giant Crocodile.
creditedArt: The existing catalog illustration is Slawomir Maniak’s Archfiend of Ifnir, the neighboring art on page 30. Keep the existing link and credit. The new portrait is an original Ammit.

name: Hippopotamus
author: James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope
section: An Amonkhet Bestiary, The Luxa River
pageNumbering: page index, counting the cover as page 1. The folios have no visible printed page numbers.
reskinEvidence: Checked the rendered Monster Manual folio and the official 2014 Basic Rules on D&D Beyond. The mobile viewer counts its cover as page 1.
printedChanges: Replace Gore with Bite, retaining its attack and damage values. Add a 30-ft. swim speed and Hold Breath. The 2014 Monster Manual errata corrects both attack damage expressions to +6.
appearanceEvidence: page 38 identifies a hippopotamus but gives no detailed appearance. The description and portrait use ordinary hippopotamus anatomy.
habitatEvidence: The Luxa River is explicit on page 38. Adjacent riverbanks are an editorial search tag inferred from that river habitat. Grassland is inherited index metadata from Elephant.
